Interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles plus 15 kHz PWM on Arduino Due (Robocon)

llm_analysis.reasoning: Real STM32 bare-metal and FreeRTOS foundations cover the peripheral and RTOS core, but the role is about owning a reusable platform with CAN, Ethernet, MISRA and multicore, none of which has backing. Keyword score is generous on adjacents; depth is closer to half-backed. Worth applying, with CAN and MISRA as the likely rejection points.
